title: Non-anchor position period prediction v23
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new observations are scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because it does not use known-plaintext anchor spans, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed key-material results, or held-out anchor controls as discovery evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more predeclared period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before scoring any new observations
Absolute one-based K4 position numbers only
Residue-class rule emitted before adding source-backed observation rows
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale
Observation archives validated before period scoring and not derived from known-plaintext anchors
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over non-anchor K4 positions
multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
no candidate-word, key-material, route, or fragment-score tuning before evaluating the target
